verdict.rationale:
Missive documents and runtime-verifies an official hosted MCP server (mcp.missiveapp.com) that external AI apps like Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor can connect to, with OAuth-scoped permissions explicitly including conversations:read/write, drafts:write, drafts:deliver (send), contacts:read, and calendars:read/write — covering read, triage, draft, and send end-to-end. This is corroborated by a live runtime probe (401 + OAuth challenge advertising exact scopes) confirming the documented capability actually exists and is reachable, not just marketing copy.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on user account of actually using Claude/ChatGPT to send an email via this MCP connection (only vendor docs + runtime probe, no third-party usage report).
